questions.why: 儘管很累 grants the hard part, and 做下去 says she will keep at it; the reasons follow: the boss looks after them and lets her off for exams, and the co-workers get along. She says it is tiring, she works nights and says nothing about days, and exams only come up as time off, not as a moment to leave.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你爸媽要你暑假回家幫忙，你決定了嗎？
lines.simplified: 听说你爸妈要你暑假回家帮忙，你决定了吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ bàmā yào nǐ shǔjià huí jiā bāngmáng, nǐ juédìng le ma?
lines.english: I heard your parents want you home to help this summer. Have you decided?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 決定回去了。一方面家裡的麵店需要人，一方面我也想趁這個機會多陪陪他們。
lines.simplified: 决定回去了。一方面家里的面店需要人，一方面我也想趁这个机会多陪陪他们。
lines.pinyin: Juédìng huíqù le. Yì fāngmiàn jiā lǐ de miàn diàn xūyào rén, yì fāngmiàn wǒ yě xiǎng chèn zhège jīhuì duō péi pei tāmen.
lines.english: I've decided to go. For one thing, our noodle shop needs help; for another, I'd like to spend more time with them.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你本來找好的那份工作呢？
lines.simplified: 那你本来找好的那份工作呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ běnlái zhǎo hǎo de nà fèn gōngzuò ne?
lines.english: Then what about the job you'd already found?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 至於打工，等寒假再說吧，機會以後還會有的。
lines.simplified: 至于打工，等寒假再说吧，机会以后还会有的。
lines.pinyin: Zhìyú dǎgōng, děng hánjià zài shuō ba, jīhuì yǐhòu hái huì yǒu de.
lines.english: As for the job, I'll think about it in the winter break. There'll be other chances.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 根據對話，可以知道什麼？
prompt.simplified: 根据对话，可以知道什么？
prompt.pinyin: Gēnjù duìhuà, kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
prompt.english: According to the conversation, what can we learn?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他暑假要留在學校打工
choices.simplified: 他暑假要留在学校打工
choices.pinyin: Tā shǔjià yào liú zài xuéxiào dǎgōng.
choices.english: He will stay at school and work this summer.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他回家只是為了幫忙
choices.simplified: 他回家只是为了帮忙
choices.pinyin: Tā huí jiā zhǐshì wèile bāngmáng.
choices.english: He is going home only to help out.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他寒假才要回家幫忙
choices.simplified: 他寒假才要回家帮忙
choices.pinyin: Tā hánjià cái yào huí jiā bāngmáng.
choices.english: He won't go home to help until winter break.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 打工的事他打算晚一點再決定
choices.simplified: 打工的事他打算晚一点再决定
choices.pinyin: Dǎgōng de shì tā dǎsuàn wǎn yìdiǎn zài juédìng.
choices.english: He will decide about the job later.

questions.why: 至於 turns to the job, and 等寒假再說 puts it off until later. He has decided to go home this summer; 一方面……一方面…… gives two reasons, helping and being with his parents; and winter break is for the job, not for going home.

focus.en: as for; for one thing…, for another…

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 恭喜妳們那組做菜比賽拿了第一名！快跟我說說比賽的經過吧。
lines.simplified: 恭喜你们那组做菜比赛拿了第一名！快跟我说说比赛的经过吧。
lines.pinyin: Gōngxǐ nǐmen nà zǔ zuò cài bǐsài ná le dì yī míng! Kuài gēn wǒ shuō shuo bǐsài de jīngguò ba.
lines.english: Congratulations on your group winning first place in the cooking contest! Tell me how it went.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 比賽的主題是剩菜變好菜，我們想到用前一天剩下的米飯做甜點。
lines.simplified: 比赛的主题是剩菜变好菜，我们想到用前一天剩下的米饭做甜点。
lines.pinyin: Bǐsài de zhǔtí shì shèngcài biàn hǎo cài, wǒmen xiǎngdào yòng qián yì tiān shèngxià de mǐfàn zuò tiándiǎn.
lines.english: The theme was turning leftovers into good food. We came up with making a dessert from the previous day's leftover rice.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 米飯做甜點？聽起來有點奇怪。
lines.simplified: 米饭做甜点？听起来有点奇怪。
lines.pinyin: Mǐfàn zuò tiándiǎn? Tīng qǐlái yǒudiǎn qíguài.
lines.english: A dessert from rice? That sounds a bit strange.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 一開始很難吃，同學都說我們白忙了。後來改進了好幾次，味道仍然不太好，直到加了牛奶跟水果，才變得好吃。
lines.simplified: 一开始很难吃，同学都说我们白忙了。后来改进了好几次，味道仍然不太好，直到加了牛奶跟水果，才变得好吃。
lines.pinyin: Yì kāishǐ hěn nánchī, tóngxué dōu shuō wǒmen bái máng le. Hòulái gǎijìn le hǎo jǐ cì, wèidào réngrán bú tài hǎo, zhídào jiā le niúnǎi gēn shuǐguǒ, cái biàn de hǎochī.
lines.english: At first it really tasted awful, and classmates said we were wasting our effort. We improved it several times and it still was not good; not until we added milk and fruit did it taste good.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 老師們覺得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 老师们觉得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshīmen juéde zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: What did the teachers think?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他們當場吃了以後說，味道不是最好的，可是我們的概念最符合主題，於是給了我們第一名。我到現在都還很得意呢。
lines.simplified: 他们当场吃了以后说，味道不是最好的，可是我们的概念最符合主题，于是给了我们第一名。我到现在都还很得意呢。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen dāngchǎng chī le yǐhòu shuō, wèidào bú shì zuì hǎo de, kěshì wǒmen de gàiniàn zuì fúhé zhǔtí, yúshì gěi le wǒmen dì yī míng. Wǒ dào xiànzài dōu hái hěn déyì ne.
lines.english: They tasted it on the spot and said the taste wasn't the best, but our concept fit the theme best, so they gave us first place. I'm still pretty pleased with myself.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那下次也做給我嚐嚐吧。
lines.simplified: 那下次也做给我尝尝吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà xià cì yě zuò gěi wǒ cháng chang ba.
lines.english: Then make some for me to try next time.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 沒問題，不過得等我家又有剩飯。
lines.simplified: 没问题，不过得等我家又有剩饭。
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí, búguò děi děng wǒ jiā yòu yǒu shèng fàn.
lines.english: Sure, but you will have to wait until my family has leftover rice again.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 她們的甜點後來是怎麼變好吃的？
prompt.simplified: 她们的甜点后来是怎么变好吃的？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen de tiándiǎn hòulái shì zěnme biàn hǎochī de?
prompt.english: How did their dessert end up tasting good?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 改用剛煮好的米飯
choices.simplified: 改用刚煮好的米饭
choices.pinyin: Gǎi yòng gāng zhǔ hǎo de mǐfàn.
choices.english: They switched to freshly cooked rice.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 照老師的意見改做法
choices.simplified: 照老师的意见改做法
choices.pinyin: Zhào lǎoshī de yìjiàn gǎi zuòfǎ.
choices.english: They changed the recipe on the teachers' advice.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在甜點裡多放了別的東西
choices.simplified: 在甜点里多放了别的东西
choices.pinyin: Zài tiándiǎn lǐ duō fàng le bié de dōngxi.
choices.english: They put other things into the dessert.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 少放一點米飯
choices.simplified: 少放一点米饭
choices.pinyin: Shǎo fàng yìdiǎn mǐfàn.
choices.english: Use a little less rice.

questions.why: The dessert still did not taste good after several attempts. Only adding milk and fruit made it taste good. They used leftover rice, and the dialogue gives no change in the amount of rice or advice from the teachers about how to make it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 老師們為什麼給她們第一名？
prompt.simplified: 老师们为什么给她们第一名？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎoshīmen wèishénme gěi tāmen dì yī míng?
prompt.english: Why did the teachers give them first place?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她們的做法最能表現主題
choices.simplified: 她们的做法最能表现主题
choices.pinyin: Tāmen de zuòfǎ zuì néng biǎoxiàn zhǔtí.
choices.english: Their approach showed the theme best.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她們的甜點味道最好
choices.simplified: 她们的甜点味道最好
choices.pinyin: Tāmen de tiándiǎn wèidào zuì hǎo.
choices.english: Their dessert tasted the best.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她們改了好幾次做法
choices.simplified: 她们改了好几次做法
choices.pinyin: Tāmen gǎi le hǎo jǐ cì zuòfǎ.
choices.english: They changed their recipe several times.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她們的甜點加了很多水果
choices.simplified: 她们的甜点加了很多水果
choices.pinyin: Tāmen de tiándiǎn jiā le hěn duō shuǐguǒ.
choices.english: Their dessert had a lot of fruit in it.

questions.why: 於是 links the teachers' decision to the reason just before it: the idea fit the theme best. They said the taste was not the best; the several tries and the fruit explain why it came to taste good, not why it won.

focus.zh: 於是（因此採取的行動）；原因
focus.en: so (an action taken because of it); the reason

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼沒有說哪一天做給男的吃？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么没有说哪一天做给男的吃？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme méiyǒu shuō nǎ yì tiān zuò gěi nán de chī?
prompt.english: Why doesn't the woman say which day she'll make it for him?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她其實不想再做這種甜點
choices.simplified: 她其实不想再做这种甜点
choices.pinyin: Tā qíshí bù xiǎng zài zuò zhè zhǒng tiándiǎn.
choices.english: She doesn't really want to make it again.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她要照比賽那樣用剩飯做
choices.simplified: 她要照比赛那样用剩饭做
choices.pinyin: Tā yào zhào bǐsài nàyàng yòng shèngfàn zuò.
choices.english: She wants to make it with leftover rice, as in the contest.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得味道還不夠好
choices.simplified: 她觉得味道还不够好
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde wèidào hái bú gòu hǎo.
choices.english: She thinks it doesn't taste good enough yet.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她得先去買牛奶跟水果
choices.simplified: 她得先去买牛奶跟水果
choices.pinyin: Tā děi xiān qù mǎi niúnǎi gēn shuǐguǒ.
choices.english: She has to buy milk and fruit first.

questions.why: 得等我家又有剩飯: the dish is the contest idea of using the previous day's leftover rice (her second line), so she can only make it when rice is left over. 沒問題 rules out refusing; the taste and the milk and fruit are earlier details, not why she gives no day.

focus.zh: 得等……；不能馬上做的原因
focus.en: have to wait until…; why it can't be right away

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 媽，我想下學期轉到農業系。
lines.simplified: 妈，我想下学期转到农业系。
lines.pinyin: Mā, wǒ xiǎng xià xuéqí zhuǎn dào nóngyè xì.
lines.english: Mom, I want to transfer to the agriculture department next semester.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 轉系？你不是一直很喜歡工業設計嗎？怎麼突然改變主意了？
lines.simplified: 转系？你不是一直很喜欢工业设计吗？怎么突然改变主意了？
lines.pinyin: Zhuǎn xì? Nǐ bú shì yìzhí hěn xǐhuān gōngyè shèjì ma? Zěnme túrán gǎibiàn zhǔyì le?
lines.english: Switch departments? Haven't you always loved industrial design? Why the sudden change of mind?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上學期我去南部的田裡打工，才發現這個領域很有意思。現在種菜都用科學的方法，跟以前完全不一樣。
lines.simplified: 上学期我去南部的田里打工，才发现这个领域很有意思。现在种菜都用科学的方法，跟以前完全不一样。
lines.pinyin: Shàng xuéqí wǒ qù nánbù de tián lǐ dǎgōng, cái fāxiàn zhège lǐngyù hěn yǒu yìsi. Xiànzài zhòng cài dōu yòng kēxué de fāngfǎ, gēn yǐqián wánquán bù yíyàng.
lines.english: Last semester I worked on a farm in the south, and that's when I found this field really interesting. Growing vegetables uses scientific methods now; it's totally different from before.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是念農業，以後的工作穩定嗎？
lines.simplified: 可是念农业，以后的工作稳定吗？
lines.pinyin: Kěshì niàn nóngyè, yǐhòu de gōngzuò wěndìng ma?
lines.english: But if you study agriculture, will you have a steady job later?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 目前這方面很需要人，老師說，畢業以後找工作相對容易。
lines.simplified: 目前这方面很需要人，老师说，毕业以后找工作相对容易。
lines.pinyin: Mùqián zhè fāngmiàn hěn xūyào rén, lǎoshī shuō, bìyè yǐhòu zhǎo gōngzuò xiāngduì róngyì.
lines.english: Right now they really need people in this area. My teacher says finding a job after graduating is relatively easy.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 既然你想清楚了，我就不說什麼了。不過轉系以前，至少先去跟農業系的老師談一談。
lines.simplified: 既然你想清楚了，我就不说什么了。不过转系以前，至少先去跟农业系的老师谈一谈。
lines.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ xiǎng qīngchǔ le, wǒ jiù bù shuō shénme le. Búguò zhuǎn xì yǐqián, zhìshǎo xiān qù gēn nóngyè xì de lǎoshī tán yi tán.
lines.english: Since you've thought it through, I won't say anything more. But before you switch, at least go and talk to the agriculture teachers first.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好，我明天下課就去。
lines.simplified: 好，我明天下课就去。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ míngtiān xiàkè jiù qù.
lines.english: OK, I'll go tomorrow after class.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是怎麼開始對農業感興趣的？
prompt.simplified: 男的是怎么开始对农业感兴趣的？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì zěnme kāishǐ duì nóngyè gǎn xìngqù de?
prompt.english: How did the man become interested in agriculture?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 聽了農業系老師的介紹
choices.simplified: 听了农业系老师的介绍
choices.pinyin: Tīng le nóngyè xì lǎoshī de jièshào.
choices.english: He heard the agriculture teachers explain it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在田裡工作過一段時間
choices.simplified: 在田里工作过一段时间
choices.pinyin: Zài tián lǐ gōngzuò guo yí duàn shíjiān.
choices.english: He worked on a farm for a while.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 上了工業設計的課
choices.simplified: 上了工业设计的课
choices.pinyin: Shàng le gōngyè shèjì de kè.
choices.english: He took industrial design classes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 媽媽要他多了解種菜
choices.simplified: 妈妈要他多了解种菜
choices.pinyin: Māma yào tā duō liǎojiě zhòng cài.
choices.english: His mother wanted him to learn about farming.

questions.why: He worked in the fields in the south last semester, and 才發現 marks that as when the field caught his interest. Talking to the agriculture teachers is what his mother asks him to do next; design is what he liked before; and his mother never pushed farming.

focus.en: reason: where the interest came from

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的怎麼看現在種菜的方法和畢業後找工作的機會？
prompt.simplified: 男的怎么看现在种菜的方法和毕业后找工作的机会？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zěnme kàn xiànzài zhòng cài de fāngfǎ hé bìyè hòu zhǎo gōngzuò de jīhuì?
prompt.english: What does the man say about how vegetables are grown today and the chances of finding a job after graduation?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 方法簡單，還能在南部打工
choices.simplified: 方法简单，还能在南部打工
choices.pinyin: Fāngfǎ jiǎndān, hái néng zài nánbù dǎgōng.
choices.english: The methods are simple, and he can work in the south.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 很有意思，老師保證給工作
choices.simplified: 很有意思，老师保证给工作
choices.pinyin: Hěn yǒu yìsi, lǎoshī bǎozhèng gěi gōngzuò.
choices.english: It is interesting, and the teacher guarantees a job.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 跟設計有關，工作也比較輕鬆
choices.simplified: 跟设计有关，工作也比较轻松
choices.pinyin: Gēn shèjì yǒuguān, gōngzuò yě bǐjiào qīngsōng.
choices.english: It is linked to design, and the work is easier.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 方法很科學，工作也不難找
choices.simplified: 方法很科学，工作也不难找
choices.pinyin: Fāngfǎ hěn kēxué, gōngzuò yě bù nán zhǎo.
choices.english: The methods are scientific, and jobs are not hard to find.

questions.why: Two turns together: 現在種菜都用科學的方法 and 畢業以後找工作相對容易. He never calls the methods simple; the teacher says jobs are relatively easy to find, not guaranteed; design is what he is leaving, and how hard the work is never comes up.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 媽媽最後的態度是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 妈妈最后的态度是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Māma zuìhòu de tàidù shì shénme?
prompt.english: What is the mother's final attitude?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 不答應，希望他繼續念設計
choices.simplified: 不答应，希望他继续念设计
choices.pinyin: Bù dāying, xīwàng tā jìxù niàn shèjì.
choices.english: She says no and wants him to keep studying design.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 答應他，要他明天就去轉系
choices.simplified: 答应他，要他明天就去转系
choices.pinyin: Dāying tā, yào tā míngtiān jiù qù zhuǎn xì.
choices.english: She agrees and wants him to transfer tomorrow.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 不再有意見，但要他先找老師談
choices.simplified: 不再有意见，但要他先找老师谈
choices.pinyin: Bú zài yǒu yìjiàn, dàn yào tā xiān zhǎo lǎoshī tán.
choices.english: She no longer objects, but wants him to talk to a teacher first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 要他先去田裡打工再決定
choices.simplified: 要他先去田里打工再决定
choices.pinyin: Yào tā xiān qù tián lǐ dǎgōng zài juédìng.
choices.english: She wants him to work on a farm before deciding.

questions.why: 既然你想清楚了，我就不說什麼了 drops her objection without cheering him on, and 至少先去跟農業系的老師談一談 is the least she asks. She does not say no, nothing is to be done tomorrow but the talk he offers, and the farm work is already behind him.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a broadcast, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 各位聽眾晚安，今天來談談剩菜。
lines.simplified: 各位听众晚安，今天来谈谈剩菜。
lines.pinyin: Gè wèi tīngzhòng wǎn'ān, jīntiān lái tán tan shèngcài.
lines.english: Good evening, listeners. Today I'd like to talk about leftovers.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我小時候家裡很窮，一家人能吃飽就很幸福了，從來沒有人敢剩下一口飯。
lines.simplified: 我小时候家里很穷，一家人能吃饱就很幸福了，从来没有人敢剩下一口饭。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎo shíhòu jiā lǐ hěn qióng, yì jiā rén néng chī bǎo jiù hěn xìngfú le, cónglái méiyǒu rén gǎn shèngxià yì kǒu fàn.
lines.english: When I was little my family was poor. Having enough to eat was happiness enough, and no one ever dared leave a mouthful of rice.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 現在生活方便了，把吃不完的飯菜白白丟掉的情況相當普遍，大家也不覺得可惜。
lines.simplified: 现在生活方便了，把吃不完的饭菜白白丢掉的情况相当普遍，大家也不觉得可惜。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài shēnghuó fāngbiàn le, bǎ chī bù wán de fàncài báibái diū diào de qíngkuàng xiāngdāng pǔbiàn, dàjiā yě bù juéde kěxí.
lines.english: Life is easier now, and it's quite common for people to throw away what they can't finish without thinking it's a waste.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 有人說，把食物丟掉是道德的問題；我卻覺得，大家只是忘了食物是怎麼來的。
lines.simplified: 有人说，把食物丢掉是道德的问题；我却觉得，大家只是忘了食物是怎么来的。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, bǎ shíwù diū diào shì dàodé de wèntí; wǒ què juéde, dàjiā zhǐshì wàng le shíwù shì zěnme lái de.
lines.english: Some say throwing food away is a moral problem. I think instead that people have simply forgotten where food comes from.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 由於上個月我在南部的鄉下住了一個星期，看到種田有多辛苦，因此現在每一頓飯我都吃得一口也不剩。
lines.simplified: 由于上个月我在南部的乡下住了一个星期，看到种田有多辛苦，因此现在每一顿饭我都吃得一口也不剩。
lines.pinyin: Yóuyú shàng ge yuè wǒ zài nánbù de xiāngxià zhù le yí ge xīngqí, kàndào zhòng tián yǒu duō xīnkǔ, yīncǐ xiànzài měi yí dùn fàn wǒ dōu chī de yì kǒu yě bú shèng.
lines.english: Because last month I spent a week in the countryside in the south and saw how hard farming is, I now finish every bite of every meal.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 所以我想請大家從今天開始做一件小事：吃多少就拿多少，以免吃不完又得丟掉。無論如何，別讓能吃的食物變成垃圾。
lines.simplified: 所以我想请大家从今天开始做一件小事：吃多少就拿多少，以免吃不完又得丢掉。无论如何，别让能吃的食物变成垃圾。
lines.pinyin: Suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng qǐng dàjiā cóng jīntiān kāishǐ zuò yí jiàn xiǎo shì: chī duōshǎo jiù ná duōshǎo, yǐmiǎn chī bù wán yòu děi diū diào. Wúlùnrúhé, bié ràng néng chī de shíwù biànchéng lèsè.
lines.english: So I'd like to ask everyone to start one small thing today: take only as much as you will eat, so you don't end up throwing the rest away. Whatever you do, don't let food that can be eaten become garbage.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 說話的人上個月去了南部以後，有什麼改變？
prompt.simplified: 说话的人上个月去了南部以后，有什么改变？
prompt.pinyin: Shuōhuà de rén shàng ge yuè qù le nánbù yǐhòu, yǒu shénme gǎibiàn?
prompt.english: What changed for the speaker after going south last month?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 開始自己在田裡種菜
choices.simplified: 开始自己在田里种菜
choices.pinyin: Kāishǐ zìjǐ zài tián lǐ zhòng cài.
choices.english: She started growing vegetables herself.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 每餐都把飯菜吃完
choices.simplified: 每餐都把饭菜吃完
choices.pinyin: Měi cān dōu bǎ fàncài chī wán.
choices.english: She finishes her food at every meal.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 覺得丟食物是道德問題
choices.simplified: 觉得丢食物是道德问题
choices.pinyin: Juéde diū shíwù shì dàodé wèntí.
choices.english: She came to see throwing food away as a moral problem.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 覺得現在生活太方便了
choices.simplified: 觉得现在生活太方便了
choices.pinyin: Juéde xiànzài shēnghuó tài fāngbiàn le.
choices.english: She came to feel life is too convenient now.

questions.why: 由於…看到種田有多辛苦，因此…吃得一口也不剩: the week on the farm is the cause, and finishing every meal is the result. She only stayed there, she did not start farming; the moral view is what others say and she disagrees; and convenience is how she describes life today, not a change in her.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 說話的人認為，很多人把食物丟掉的原因是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 说话的人认为，很多人把食物丢掉的原因是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Shuōhuà de rén rènwéi, hěn duō rén bǎ shíwù diū diào de yuányīn shì shénme?
prompt.english: Why does the speaker think many people throw food away?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們忘了食物得來不容易
choices.simplified: 他们忘了食物得来不容易
choices.pinyin: Tāmen wàng le shíwù dé lái bù róngyì.
choices.english: They have forgotten how hard food is to come by.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們的道德觀念有問題
choices.simplified: 他们的道德观念有问题
choices.pinyin: Tāmen de dàodé guānniàn yǒu wèntí.
choices.english: Their sense of morality is at fault.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們覺得剩菜放不久
choices.simplified: 他们觉得剩菜放不久
choices.pinyin: Tāmen juéde shèngcài fàng bù jiǔ.
choices.english: They think leftovers do not keep for long.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們的飯菜做得太多了
choices.simplified: 他们的饭菜做得太多了
choices.pinyin: Tāmen de fàncài zuò de tài duō le.
choices.english: They cook too much food.

questions.why: She says people have forgotten where food comes from, and her story about farming shows how much work goes into it. She attributes the moral view to others and never blames how long leftovers keep or how much people cook.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下面哪一種做法，最符合說話的人的建議？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一种做法，最符合说话的人的建议？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yì zhǒng zuòfǎ, zuì fúhé shuōhuà de rén de jiànyì?
prompt.english: Which of these best follows the speaker's suggestion?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 多拿一點，以免不夠吃
choices.simplified: 多拿一点，以免不够吃
choices.pinyin: Duō ná yìdiǎn, yǐmiǎn bú gòu chī.
choices.english: Take extra so as not to go hungry.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 去鄉下體會種田的辛苦
choices.simplified: 去乡下体会种田的辛苦
choices.pinyin: Qù xiāngxià tǐhuì zhòng tián de xīnkǔ.
choices.english: Go to the countryside to feel how hard farming is.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 跟大家討論道德的問題
choices.simplified: 跟大家讨论道德的问题
choices.pinyin: Gēn dàjiā tǎolùn dàodé de wèntí.
choices.english: Discuss the moral question with others.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先拿一點，不夠再去拿
choices.simplified: 先拿一点，不够再去拿
choices.pinyin: Xiān ná yìdiǎn, bú gòu zài qù ná.
choices.english: Take a little first and go back for more if it isn't enough.

questions.why: Her one request is 吃多少就拿多少，以免吃不完: taking a little and going back for more is that rule in practice. Taking extra 以免不夠 turns her 以免 around; the countryside week was her own story, not a request; and the moral view is the one she sets aside.

focus.zh: 以免；把建議用在新的情形
focus.en: so as to avoid; applying the advice to a new case

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 林老師您好，我是大山鄉服務中心的工作人員，想跟您說明下星期三你們班來參觀的事。
lines.simplified: 林老师您好，我是大山乡服务中心的工作人员，想跟您说明下星期三你们班来参观的事。
lines.pinyin: Lín lǎoshī nín hǎo, wǒ shì Dàshān Xiāng fúwù zhōngxīn de gōngzuò rényuán, xiǎng gēn nín shuōmíng xià xīngqísān nǐmen bān lái cānguān de shì.
lines.english: Hello, Teacher Lin. I'm on the staff of the Dashan Township service center, and I'm calling about your class's visit next Wednesday.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們大山鄉面積不大，人口只有兩千多人，大家的生活跟玉米的關係十分密切。
lines.simplified: 我们大山乡面积不大，人口只有两千多人，大家的生活跟玉米的关系十分密切。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen Dàshān Xiāng miànjī bú dà, rénkǒu zhǐ yǒu liǎng qiān duō rén, dàjiā de shēnghuó gēn yùmǐ de guānxi shífēn mìqiè.
lines.english: Dashan Township isn't large, with a population of just over two thousand, and life here is closely tied to corn.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 由於最近一連下了好幾天的雨，田裡的路很難走，因此原來安排的下田活動，改成在室內看影片、聽介紹。
lines.simplified: 由于最近一连下了好几天的雨，田里的路很难走，因此原来安排的下田活动，改成在室内看影片、听介绍。
lines.pinyin: Yóuyú zuìjìn yìlián xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de yǔ, tián lǐ de lù hěn nán zǒu, yīncǐ yuánlái ānpái de xià tián huódòng, gǎi chéng zài shìnèi kàn yǐngpiàn, tīng jièshào.
lines.english: Because it has rained for several days in a row, the paths in the fields are hard to walk, so the field activity we planned has been changed to watching a film and hearing a talk indoors.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們會介紹一位科學家發明的新方法。這個方法使得這裡的玉米越種越好。
lines.simplified: 我们会介绍一位科学家发明的新方法。这个方法使得这里的玉米越种越好。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen huì jièshào yí wèi kēxuéjiā fāmíng de xīn fāngfǎ. Zhège fāngfǎ shǐde zhèlǐ de yùmǐ yuè zhòng yuè hǎo.
lines.english: We'll introduce a new method a scientist invented. The method has helped people here grow better and better corn.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 參觀完以後，每位同學都可以帶一袋玉米回去。班上的人數要是有改變，請在星期一以前回電話給我。
lines.simplified: 参观完以后，每位同学都可以带一袋玉米回去。班上的人数要是有改变，请在星期一以前回电话给我。
lines.pinyin: Cānguān wán yǐhòu, měi wèi tóngxué dōu kěyǐ dài yí dài yùmǐ huíqù. Bān shàng de rénshù yàoshì yǒu gǎibiàn, qǐng zài xīngqíyī yǐqián huí diànhuà gěi wǒ.
lines.english: After the visit every student can take a bag of corn home. If the number of students changes, please call me back before Monday.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下星期三的參觀，同學們會做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 下星期三的参观，同学们会做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Xià xīngqísān de cānguān, tóngxuémen huì zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What will the students do on next Wednesday's visit?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下田看玉米，再聽科學家介紹
choices.simplified: 下田看玉米，再听科学家介绍
choices.pinyin: Xià tián kàn yùmǐ, zài tīng kēxuéjiā jièshào.
choices.english: Go into the fields, then hear the scientist speak.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在室內聽介紹，再去田裡看
choices.simplified: 在室内听介绍，再去田里看
choices.pinyin: Zài shìnèi tīng jièshào, zài qù tián lǐ kàn.
choices.english: Hear a talk indoors, then go to the fields.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 請科學家到學校來介紹
choices.simplified: 请科学家到学校来介绍
choices.pinyin: Qǐng kēxuéjiā dào xuéxiào lái jièshào.
choices.english: Have the scientist come to the school.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在室內聽介紹，再帶玉米回家
choices.simplified: 在室内听介绍，再带玉米回家
choices.pinyin: Zài shìnèi tīng jièshào, zài dài yùmǐ huí jiā.
choices.english: Hear a talk indoors, then take corn home.

questions.why: Two parts of the message: the field visit is replaced by 在室內看影片、聽介紹, and 參觀完以後 each student takes a bag of corn. Going into the fields was the first plan, there is no field visit after the talk, and the scientist is only the subject of the talk.

focus.zh: 兩個訊息：改變的活動與參觀後
focus.en: two parts: the changed activity and what follows

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 為什麼要改變原來的安排？
prompt.simplified: 为什么要改变原来的安排？
prompt.pinyin: Wèishénme yào gǎibiàn yuánlái de ānpái?
prompt.english: Why was the original arrangement changed?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 大山鄉的面積太小了
choices.simplified: 大山乡的面积太小了
choices.pinyin: Dàshān Xiāng de miànjī tài xiǎo le.
choices.english: The township is too small.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 雨下得太多，田裡不好走
choices.simplified: 雨下得太多，田里不好走
choices.pinyin: Yǔ xià de tài duō, tián lǐ bù hǎo zǒu.
choices.english: Too much rain has made the fields hard to walk.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 班上的人數改變了
choices.simplified: 班上的人数改变了
choices.pinyin: Bān shàng de rénshù gǎibiàn le.
choices.english: The class size has changed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 科學家要來做介紹
choices.simplified: 科学家要来做介绍
choices.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā yào lái zuò jièshào.
choices.english: The scientist is coming to give a talk.

questions.why: 由於 gives the cause, days of rain making the field paths hard to walk, and 因此 the change. The small area is background; a change in numbers is only a possibility he asks to hear about; and the talk is about the scientist's method, not by him.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 如果班上有兩位同學不能去，林老師應該怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 如果班上有两位同学不能去，林老师应该怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Rúguǒ bān shàng yǒu liǎng wèi tóngxué bù néng qù, Lín lǎoshī yīnggāi zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: If two students can't go, what should Teacher Lin do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 星期一前打電話
choices.simplified: 星期一前打电话
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíyī qián dǎ diànhuà.
choices.english: Call before Monday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 星期三當天再跟中心說
choices.simplified: 星期三当天再跟中心说
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísān dàngtiān zài gēn zhōngxīn shuō.
choices.english: Tell the centre on the Wednesday itself.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 參觀完再打電話
choices.simplified: 参观完再打电话
choices.pinyin: Cānguān wán zài dǎ diànhuà.
choices.english: Call after the visit.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 星期二打電話
choices.simplified: 星期二打电话
choices.pinyin: Xīngqí'èr dǎ diànhuà.
choices.english: Call on Tuesday.

questions.why: The message says to call before Monday if the class headcount changes (人數要是有改變，請在星期一以前回電話). Two students dropping out changes the headcount. Tuesday, Wednesday and after the visit are all too late.

focus.en: applying the message to a new case

passage.traditional: 我哥哥是廚師，三年前跟朋友{1}開了一家小餐廳。剛開始生意不太穩定，令他十分煩惱。他不斷{2}做菜的方法，{3}客人仍然不多，每天都有不少米飯和麵條被丟掉。{4}他決定晚上九點以後，把還沒賣完的食物便宜賣給附近的學生。這個做法很有效，得到大家的{5}，使得店裡的客人一天比一天多。現在一到晚上，溫暖的燈光下，每張餐桌都坐滿了人。哥哥{6}地說，這是他想出來的辦法，以後他再也不把能吃的食物當作垃圾了。
passage.simplified: 我哥哥是厨师，三年前跟朋友{1}开了一家小餐厅。刚开始生意不太稳定，令他十分烦恼。他不断{2}做菜的方法，{3}客人仍然不多，每天都有不少米饭和面条被丢掉。{4}他决定晚上九点以后，把还没卖完的食物便宜卖给附近的学生。这个做法很有效，得到大家的{5}，使得店里的客人一天比一天多。现在一到晚上，温暖的灯光下，每张餐桌都坐满了人。哥哥{6}地说，这是他想出来的办法，以后他再也不把能吃的食物当作垃圾了。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ gēge shì chúshī, sān nián qián gēn péngyǒu tóuzī kāi le yì jiā xiǎo cāntīng. Gāng kāishǐ shēngyì bú tài wěndìng, lìng tā shífēn fánnǎo. Tā búduàn gǎijìn zuò cài de fāngfǎ, jiéguǒ kèrén réngrán bù duō, měi tiān dōu yǒu bù shǎo mǐfàn hé miàntiáo bèi diū diào. Yúshì tā juédìng wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn yǐhòu, bǎ hái méi mài wán de shíwù piányí mài gěi fùjìn de xuéshēng. Zhège zuòfǎ hěn yǒuxiào, dédào dàjiā de kěndìng, shǐde diàn lǐ de kèrén yì tiān bǐ yì tiān duō. passage.english: My older brother is a chef. Three years ago he and a friend invested in opening a small restaurant. At first business was not very stable, which worried him a great deal. He kept improving the way he cooked, yet in the end there were still few customers, and every day a lot of rice and noodles were thrown away. So he decided that after nine in the evening he would sell the unsold food cheaply to students nearby. This worked well and won everyone's approval, causing the customers in the restaurant to grow day by day. Now, as soon as evening comes, every dining table is full under the warm lights. My brother says proudly that this was his own idea, and that from now on he will never again treat food that can be eaten as garbage.

text.traditional:
目前全球人口不斷增加，可以種田的土地面積卻越來越小，不少人擔心將來食物會不夠。於是許多國家提供經費，讓科學家在農業領域進行研究。這幾十年來，他們發明了不少新方法，使得同樣大小的田能種出更多的米和玉米。
不過，有一位研究人員從不同的角度來看這個問題。記者訪問他的時候，他表示，「食物不夠」這個說法其實不正確，因為理論上，全世界每年生產的食物夠所有的人吃。真正的問題是，在工業發達的國家，有三分之一的食物還沒吃就被丟掉了；在一些很窮的地區，卻有很多人連一天兩頓飯都吃不飽。
他的觀點是，丟掉食物的行為在這些國家十分普遍，這跟社會的觀念有密切的關係：東西越容易買到，人們就越不愛惜。因此，只發明新方法仍然無法解決問題，更重要的是改變大家的觀念。他的研究也證明，只要每個人少丟一點，就能讓許多人有飯吃。既然如此，食物問題就不能只留給科學家去解決，這是所有人共同的責任。
text.simplified:

不过，有一位研究人员从不同的角度来看这个问题。记者访问他的时候，他表示，「食物不够」这个说法其实不正确，因为理论上，全世界每年生产的食物够所有的人吃。真正的问题是，在工业发达的国家，有三分之一的食物还没吃就被丢掉了；在一些很穷的地区，却有很多人连一天两顿饭都吃不饱。

text.pinyin: Mùqián quánqiú rénkǒu búduàn zēngjiā, kěyǐ zhòngtián de tǔdì miànjī què yuè lái yuè xiǎo, bù shǎo rén dānxīn jiānglái shíwù huì bú gòu. Yúshì xǔduō guójiā tígōng jīngfèi, ràng kēxuéjiā zài nóngyè lǐngyù jìnxíng yánjiù. Zhè jǐ shí nián lái, tāmen fāmíng le bù shǎo xīn fāngfǎ, shǐde tóngyàng dàxiǎo de tián néng zhòng chū gèng duō de mǐ hé yùmǐ. Búguò, yǒu yí wèi yánjiù rényuán cóng bùtóng de jiǎodù lái kàn zhège wèntí. Jìzhě fǎngwèn tā de shíhòu, tā biǎoshì, "shíwù bú gòu" zhège shuōfǎ qíshí bú zhèngquè, yīnwèi lǐlùn shàng, quán shìjiè měi nián shēngchǎn de shíwù gòu suǒyǒu de rén chī. Zhēnzhèng de wèntí shì, zài gōngyè fādá de guójiā, yǒu sān fēn zhī yī de shíwù hái méi chī jiù bèi diū diào le; zài yìxiē hěn qióng de dìqū, què yǒu hěn duō rén lián yì tiān liǎng dùn fàn dōu chī bù bǎo. Tā de guāndiǎn shì, diū diào shíwù de xíngwéi zài zhèxiē guójiā shífēn pǔbiàn, zhè gēn shèhuì de guānniàn yǒu mìqiè de guānxì: dōngxi yuè róngyì mǎi dào, rénmen jiù yuè bú àixí. Yīncǐ, zhǐ fāmíng xīn fāngfǎ réngrán wúfǎ jiějué wèntí, gèng zhòngyào de shì gǎibiàn dàjiā de guānniàn. Tā de yánjiù yě zhèngmíng, zhǐyào měi ge rén shǎo diū yìdiǎn, jiù néng ràng xǔduō rén yǒu fàn chī. Jìrán rúcǐ, shíwù wèntí jiù bù néng zhǐ liú gěi kēxuéjiā qù jiějué, zhè shì suǒyǒu rén gòngtóng de zérèn.
text.english:
At present the world's population keeps growing while the area of land that can be farmed gets smaller and smaller, and many people worry that one day there will not be enough food. So many countries provide funding for scientists to do research in the field of agriculture. Over the past few decades they have invented many new methods, which let a field of the same size grow more rice and corn.
But one researcher looks at the problem from a different angle. When a reporter interviewed him, he said that the claim "not enough food" is actually not correct, because in theory the food the whole world produces each year is enough for everyone to eat. The real problem is that in industrially developed countries a third of the food is thrown away before it is eaten, while in some very poor regions many people cannot even get two full meals a day.
His view is that throwing food away is very common in these countries, and that this is closely tied to how a society thinks: the easier things are to buy, the less people cherish them. So inventing new methods alone still cannot solve the problem; what matters more is changing how everyone thinks. His research also proves that if each person throws away a little less, many people can have food to eat. Since that is so, the food problem cannot just be left for scientists to solve; it is a responsibility everyone shares.

text.traditional:
林小姐本來在銀行上班。三年前，她回到家鄉，投資開了一家小公司，只賣樣子不好看的蔬菜和水果。

剛開始，客人普遍認為醜的東西品質一定不好，使得公司的生意很不穩定，令她十分煩惱。可是她不想把公司關掉，於是請了一位有名的廚師用這些蔬菜做菜，讓客人當場吃吃看。客人吃了都很驚訝，這證明了好不好吃跟樣子無關。
目前，她的公司跟一百多位種菜的人合作，生意也穩定多了，不過大超市仍然不願意跟她合作。記者訪問她的時候，問她最得意的是什麼。她說，不是公司賣了多少蔬菜，是越來越多人接受了她的觀點：一切能吃的食物都有價值。她還說，無論如何，她都會堅持到底。

text.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě běnlái zài yínháng shàngbān. Sān nián qián, tā huí dào jiāxiāng, tóuzī kāi le yì jiā xiǎo gōngsī, zhǐ mài yàngzi bù hǎokàn de shūcài hé shuǐguǒ. Zài nóngyè fādá de jīntiān, chāoshì lǐ de shūcài dàxiǎo dōu chàbùduō, yàngzi yě hěn piàoliàng. Kěshì hěn shǎo rén zhīdào, yóuyú chāoshì zhǐ shōu yàngzi hǎokàn de, shǐde tián lǐ dàyuē sān fēn zhī yī de shūcài wúfǎ mài chūqù, hái méi líkāi tián jiù bèi dāngzuò lèsè diū diào le. Lín xiǎojiě rènwéi, cóng dàodé de jiǎodù lái kàn, zhèyàng de xíngwéi shì bú duì de, yīnwèi zhèxiē shūcài de yíngyǎng hé wèidào yìdiǎn yě bú chà. Gāng kāishǐ, kèrén pǔbiàn rènwéi chǒu de dōngxi pǐnzhí yídìng bù hǎo, shǐde gōngsī de shēngyì hěn bù wěndìng, lìng tā shífēn fánnǎo. Kěshì tā bù xiǎng bǎ gōngsī guān diào, yúshì qǐng le yí wèi yǒumíng de chúshī yòng zhèxiē shūcài zuò cài, ràng kèrén dāngchǎng chī chi kàn. Kèrén chī le dōu hěn jīngyà, zhè zhèngmíng le hǎo bù hǎochī gēn yàngzi wúguān. Mùqián, tā de gōngsī gēn yìbǎi duō wèi zhòng cài de rén hézuò, shēngyì yě wěndìng duō le, búguò dà chāoshì réngrán bú yuànyì gēn tā hézuò. Jìzhě fǎngwèn tā de shíhòu, wèn tā zuì déyì de shì shénme. Tā shuō, bú shì gōngsī mài le duōshǎo shūcài, shì yuè lái yuè duō rén jiēshòu le tā de guāndiǎn: yíqiè néng chī de shíwù dōu yǒu jiàzhí. Tā hái shuō, wúlùnrúhé, tā dōu huì jiānchí dàodǐ.
text.english:
Ms. Lin used to work in a bank. Three years ago she went back to her hometown and invested in starting a small company that sells nothing but fruit and vegetables that do not look good.
Now that farming is so advanced, the vegetables in a supermarket are all about the same size and look lovely. But few people know that because supermarkets only take good-looking ones, about a third of the vegetables in the fields cannot be sold and are thrown away as garbage before they even leave the field. Ms. Lin thinks that from a moral point of view this is wrong, because these vegetables are every bit as nutritious and tasty.
At first, customers generally thought that ugly things must be poor in quality, making the company's business very unstable and worrying her a great deal. But she did not want to close the company, so she asked a well-known chef to cook with these vegetables and let customers taste the dishes on the spot. The customers were surprised when they ate them, and this proved that how something tastes has nothing to do with how it looks.
At present her company works with more than a hundred growers and business is much steadier, though big supermarkets are still unwilling to work with her. When a reporter interviewed her and asked what she was proudest of, she said it was not how many vegetables the company had sold, but that more and more people had accepted her view: all food that can be eaten has value. She also said that whatever happens, she will see it through to the end.

questions.why: Customers believed ugly vegetables must be poor (客人普遍認為……), 於是 she let them taste, they were surprised, and 這證明了好不好吃跟樣子無關: the tasting is there to show that looks do not decide taste. The chef's fame only got people to try, "things must look good to sell" is the belief the tasting proved wrong, and seeing it through belongs to the last paragraph.
